name: Framing note / vision
deliverable: Short document framing the product intent, target users and success criteria that later requirements must satisfy.

name: Business case / opportunity
deliverable: Cost/benefit case justifying the investment, with the value hypothesis the roadmap and scope must deliver against.

name: Feasibility study
deliverable: Technical and economic assessment of viable options, screening out approaches that cannot meet the stated requirement.

name: Product roadmap
deliverable: Time-phased plan of releases and capabilities committing WHEN each requirement area will be addressed.

name: Requirements specification / SOW
deliverable: Contractual statement of work translating the business need into scoped, chargeable requirement items.

name: Requirements spec (SRS)
deliverable: Structured software requirements specification stating each functional need in a verifiable, testable form.

name: Requirements / NFR
deliverable: Non-functional requirements (performance, security, availability…) the solution must meet alongside its functional behaviour.

name: User stories / backlog
deliverable: Backlog of user-facing stories with acceptance criteria, the agile-format restatement of the requirements.

name: Traceability matrix
deliverable: Matrix linking each requirement to its design, code and test artefacts, evidencing nothing is missed or orphaned.

name: Glossary / domain model
deliverable: Shared vocabulary and domain model resolving ambiguity in how requirement terms are interpreted across teams.

name: Architecture document (TAD)
deliverable: Architecture document describing the system structure chosen to satisfy the requirements and NFRs.

name: Detailed design (SDD)
deliverable: Detailed design translating the architecture into components, data and algorithms ready for implementation.

name: UML models / diagrams
deliverable: UML diagrams (class, sequence, state…) formalising the design so it can be reviewed and implemented consistently.

name: Interface spec (ICD/API)
deliverable: Interface contract (API/ICD) specifying inputs, outputs and protocols so integrating parties build to the same requirement.

name: Architecture decisions (ADR)
deliverable: Log of significant architecture decisions with rationale, so design choices remain traceable to the requirement they satisfy.

name: Threat model / security by-design
deliverable: Threat model and mitigations built into the design, addressing security requirements before code is written.

name: Source code
deliverable: The executable source code implementing the requirements as specified in the design.

name: Code review
deliverable: Peer review record confirming the code matches the design intent and coding standards before merge.

name: Inline documentation
deliverable: In-code comments and docstrings explaining implementation logic for future maintainers, tied to the requirement it fulfils.

name: Infra-as-Code
deliverable: Declarative infrastructure definitions (Terraform/Ansible…) provisioning the environments the solution requires to run.

name: Configuration data
deliverable: Environment and application configuration values needed to run the solution as specified.

name: Unit test plan
deliverable: Plan defining what unit-level behaviour will be tested and how, mapped back to functional requirements.

name: Unit test cases
deliverable: Concrete unit test cases verifying individual functions or components meet their specified behaviour.

name: Test code / mocks
deliverable: Automated test code and mock/stub harnesses exercising the unit test cases.

name: Coverage report
deliverable: Report quantifying code exercised by tests, evidencing how much of the requirement is actually verified.

name: Integration plan
deliverable: Plan sequencing how components are assembled and tested together to verify inter-module requirements.

name: Integration test cases
deliverable: Test cases verifying that integrated components interact correctly per the interface specifications.

name: Test datasets
deliverable: Representative data sets used to exercise integration and system tests realistically.

name: CI/CD pipelines
deliverable: Automated build/test/deploy pipelines that continuously verify and package the solution.

name: Integration reports
deliverable: Consolidated report of integration test outcomes, evidencing inter-component requirements are met.

name: Validation / acceptance plan
deliverable: Plan defining the scenarios and criteria for validating the system against business/user needs.

name: Acceptance book / system cases
deliverable: Full set of system-level acceptance test cases derived from user stories and business requirements.

name: Regression tests
deliverable: Test suite re-run on every change to confirm previously satisfied requirements still hold.

name: Validation report
deliverable: Report summarising validation test results against the business acceptance criteria.

name: Acceptance sign-off report
deliverable: Formal sign-off record confirming the business owner accepts the delivered solution.

name: Qualification dossier
deliverable: Consolidated dossier of evidence that the qualification/certification requirements have been met.

name: Compliance report
deliverable: Report mapping delivered functionality to the regulatory or contractual compliance requirements it satisfies.

name: Delivery dossier (SDF)
deliverable: Software delivery file: the consolidated package of artefacts handed over at release.

name: Release note
deliverable: Note describing what changed in the release, referencing the requirements/fixes it addresses.

name: Compliance attestation
deliverable: Signed statement attesting the delivered product complies with the applicable regulatory requirements.

name: Deployment plan
deliverable: Plan detailing how, when and by whom the solution will be deployed to production.

name: Runbook / procedures
deliverable: Step-by-step operational procedures enabling support teams to run and recover the solution.

name: User documentation
deliverable: End-user-facing documentation explaining how to use the delivered functionality.

name: Go-live dossier
deliverable: Checklist/dossier confirming all go-live conditions (data, access, rollback) are satisfied before cutover.

name: Incident analysis
deliverable: Root-cause analysis of a production incident, identifying which requirement or design gap it exposed.

name: Fixes / patches
deliverable: Corrective code changes resolving defects found in production, tied to the original requirement.

name: Maintenance documentation
deliverable: Documentation updated to reflect the current state of the system for ongoing maintenance.

name: Monitoring / SLA reports
deliverable: Periodic reports on system health and SLA adherence against the operational requirements.

name: Minor changes
deliverable: Small enhancement changes delivered outside the main release cycle.

name: Decommissioning plan
deliverable: Plan defining how a system component will be safely retired from production.

name: Migration / reversibility plan
deliverable: Plan for migrating data/functionality and the fallback path if migration must be reversed.

name: Archiving / retention
deliverable: Record of what data is archived, where, and for how long, per retention requirements.

name: Closure dossier
deliverable: Final dossier closing out the engagement: outcomes, lessons learned, formal sign-off.
